messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into French, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE French line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑by‑Word Mapping Table (Italian → French)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation (FR → EN) | Status | |-------------|-----------------------|--------------------|-----------------------------|--------| | A | preposition “to” (direction toward addressees) | **À** | to | OK | | le | definite article, plural feminine “the” (determiner) | – *(omitted)* | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | quai | relative pronoun, plural “whom” (addressees) | **ceux** | those | OK | | poi | adverb “thereafter”, temporal succession | **ensuite** | afterwards | OK | | se | subordinating conjunction “if” (condition) | **si** | if | OK | | tu | 2nd‑person singular pronoun “thou” (addressee) | **tu** | you | OK | | vorrai | future verb of volition “wilt” | **veux** | want / will want | OK | | salire | infinitive “ascend” | **monter** | to climb / ascend | OK | | anima | noun “soul” (entity compared) | **âme** | soul | OK | | fia | future copular verb “shall be” | **sera** | will be | OK | | a | preposition introducing the domain “for” | **à** | for / to (in this context) | OK | | ciò | demonstrative pronoun “that” (refers to ascent) | **cela** | that | OK | | più | comparative adverb “more” (greater degree) | **plus** | more | OK | | di | preposition of comparison “than” | **que** | than | OK | | me | 1st‑person pronoun “I” (standard of comparison) | **moi** | me / I | OK | | degna | adjective “worthy” (predicative) | **digne** | worthy | OK | | con | preposition “with” (introduces companion) | **avec** | with | OK | | lei | 3rd‑person feminine pronoun “her” (companion) | **elle** | her / she | OK | | ti | 2nd‑person pronoun object “thee” (addressee) | **te** | you (object) | OK | | lascerò | future verb “will leave” | **laisserai** | will leave | OK | | nel | contraction “in the” → locative “at the” | **à** | at / to (in this context) | OK | | mio | possessive adjective “my” | **mon** | my | OK | | partire | infinitive nominalized “departure” | **départ** | departure | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *le* – the Italian definite article is not needed in French; its meaning is absorbed by the demonstrative pronoun *ceux*.
No source words are **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or exhibit **GRAMMAR** problems in the French rendering.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only French script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final French text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: À ceux, si tu veux ensuite monter, - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 2: - Original: une âme sera à cela plus digne que moi : - Issue: none - Corrected: no change - Line 3: - Original: avec elle je te laisserai à mon départ; - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` À ceux, si tu veux ensuite monter, une âme sera à cela plus digne que moi : avec elle je te laisserai à mon départ; ```
